en: Ow... ouch... I'm so hurt... how could you let me DIE like this? I feel so weak (T⌓T)

Not because of you, it seems… (¬д¬。) There's only one thing in this world that can make me feel better... I want to play with you (＾ω＾)
But now? Can't it be later? It's the middle of the night.
OOOWW THE PAIN, IT'S COMING щ(ºДºщ) I FEEL DEATH CALLING ME ∑(〇Д◎ﾉ)ﾉ goodbye cruel world…(〒^〒)

For our task you will need: some soul sand, 5 Sürth candles and some kind of... red pigment ◔_◔ whathever you can get.
But be very careful ( º_º ) there are many monsters in the night, they might try to stop our game, so don't let them catch you (●__●)
